topics.description: Multiple sources are reporting on allegations of fraud in Minnesota's child care programs. The Trump administration has frozen child care payments following publication of a right-wing propaganda video. Inspectors have found day cares 'operating as expected' despite viral video fraud claims.

Multiple sources are reporting on the capture of Venezuelan leader Maduro. The US is running the 'direction' of Venezuela after Maduro's ouster. Trump's administration is set to brief lawmakers on the situation.
